name: sol-advisor
description: Codex-native architect orchestration with opencode-go/deepseek-v4-flash / High implementation, a fresh GPT-5.6 Sol / High review, and parent-owned verification and acceptance.

interface.shortDescription: Delegate implementation to opencode-go/deepseek-v4-flash / High and require a fresh Sol / High review.
interface.longDescription: Sol Advisor runs in the parent Codex chat as the architect. It delegates implementation to the pinned opencode-go/deepseek-v4-flash / High custom agent and requires a fresh GPT-5.6 Sol / High review before completion. The parent owns architecture, the complete five-part specification, diff verification, correction loops, and acceptance. The two custom-agent TOML files must be copied into ~/.codex/agents/ once; Codex discovers them only there.
defaultPrompt: Use Sol Advisor's native lane to build this feature, verify it, and obtain the fresh Sol review before completion.
